title: The Elf on the Shelf Arrival Breakfast
description: An Elf on the Shelf arrival breakfast from Sam's Club: the Scout Elf and carrier bundle, the 24 Day Elf Ideas Super Set, the Advent Calendar story collection, a light-up Santa book, a sage flip waffle maker and candy cane kitchen towels.
intro: The elf shows up at our house the morning after Thanksgiving, and the first year I made the rookie mistake of having nothing planned. Cold cereal and a doll on a shelf. Never again. Now the elf arrives with waffles. The Santa book glows on the table, the Advent Calendar book sits by the plates, and the Super Set means I already know where that elf is hiding for the next 24 nights. I get to look organized for exactly one month a year, and I am taking it.

sections.heading: The elf arrives
paragraphs: The Sam's Club exclusive Elf on the Shelf: A Christmas Tradition boxset with the Scout Elf Carrier bundle, the Elf on the Shelf 24 Day Elf Ideas Super Set and the Elf on the Shelf Advent Calendar Story and Activity Collection.

sections.heading: The breakfast table
paragraphs: The Member's Mark pre-lit animated musical holiday book in the Twas the Night Before Christmas design, the Dash flip Belgian waffle maker in sage, and the Member's Mark holiday kitchen towel set in Candy Cane.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The table, the waffles, the mugs and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
